label: Product Owner routes one primary intent to one resource lane and discovers routable material from references and assets; its manifest declares references, assets, and the manual-testing playbook as its leaf roots, so embedding mcp-figma requires an explicit FigJam route and resource inventory rather than an unreferenced folder copy. Copying mcp-figma’s instructions does not provide its tools: Product Owner currently declares Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, and WebSearch, while mcp-figma declares Bash and Code Mode MCP; its documented CLI path also depends on an open Figma Desktop file, Node.js 18 or newer, and the full CLI version. Make the plugin/runtime expose and verify those dependencies before the FigJam route claims generation capability. The upstream skill covers broad Figma authoring, modification, export, and optional context retrieval, while the Product Owner specification requires FigJam as the only output; retain a verbatim vendored upstream subtree and put the output restriction in a narrow Product Owner FigJam route/adapter that exposes only named FigJam commands by default.
